def create(text, registry):
    """Compile one policy string against the service registry."""
    rules, atoms, symbols = parse(text)      # raises PolicyError
    names = {s['name'] for s in registry}
    check_registry(rules, names)              # raises RegistryError
    ordered = sorted(registry, key=lambda s: s['label'])
    columns = [s['label'] for s in ordered]
    index = {s['name']: i for i, s in enumerate(ordered)}
    if VERIFY:
        from compiler import compiler as reference
        image = reference.compile_rules(rules, columns, index)
        fast = compile_rules(rules, columns, index)
        if fast != image: raise PolicyError('engine disagreement')
        return image
    return compile_rules(rules, columns, index)
